Full range BRANT range covers the needs of paint shops of factories producing furniture, doors, window frames. The range includes polyurethane, acrylic, polyester, nitrocellulose and water-based products for interior and exterior use. Tinting system allows customers to get a coating of any color. Tinting system Automatic tinting system is based on in-house pigment pastes suitable for wood and metal coatings. Regularly updated formula database is available online. The Colorfactory team
